findings.description: Import of 'performance_attribution' from quant_nanggroe.engine.analytics fails at runtime — this function does not exist. analytics/__init__.py exports: PerformanceMetrics, benchmark_returns, compute_metrics, rolling_sharpe, strategy_comparison only
findings.fix: Replace call with compute_metrics() from same package or implement performance_attribution()

findings.description: PerformanceMetrics(returns=req.returns, rfr=req.risk_free_rate) will raise TypeError: PerformanceMetrics is a @dataclass with fields [total_return, annualized_return, sharpe, ...] — it has no 'returns' or 'rfr' fields. The route treats it as a calculator but it is a result container
findings.fix: Use compute_metrics(returns=req.returns, risk_free_rate=req.risk_free_rate) instead

findings.description: pm.all_metrics() does not exist on PerformanceMetrics. Available methods: to_dict(), summary(). This raises AttributeError at runtime
findings.fix: Replace pm.all_metrics() with pm.to_dict() or use compute_metrics() which returns populated PerformanceMetrics

findings.description: PerformanceMetrics(returns=req.returns_a) — same TypeError as line 34. No 'returns' field exists on dataclass
findings.fix: Use compute_metrics(returns=req.returns_a) instead

findings.description: pm_a.all_metrics() does not exist — same AttributeError as line 37
findings.fix: Replace pm_a.all_metrics() with correct method call
